description: This file implements a database driver for Microsoft SQL Server accessed via ODBC in the ADOdb PHP library. It defines a class extending a generic ODBC class to handle MSSQL-specific SQL syntax, metadata retrieval, date formatting, limit/offset queries, and other database interactions. It also includes a record set class tailored for MSSQL.

classes.name: ADODB_odbc_mssql
classes.description: A class that extends ADODB_odbc to implement MSSQL-specific SQL syntax, metadata retrieval, and connection behaviors using ODBC.

classes.name: ADORecordSet_odbc_mssql
classes.description: A class extending ADORecordSet_odbc for MSSQL-specific record set handling.

methods.name: ServerInfo
methods.description: Retrieves server version and description info from MSSQL server using stored procedure 'sp_server_info'.

methods.name: IfNull
methods.description: Returns SQL for NULL checking using ISNULL, specific to MSSQL.

methods.name: _insertID
methods.description: Fetches last inserted identity value using SCOPE_IDENTITY().

methods.name: metaForeignKeys
methods.description: Retrieves foreign key constraints for a table from sysforeignkeys system table.

methods.name: MetaTables
methods.description: Retrieves list of tables with optional filtering by name pattern.

methods.name: MetaColumns
methods.description: Retrieves column metadata for a table, including type, length, and nullability.

methods.name: MetaIndexes
methods.description: Retrieves index information for a table.

methods.name: _query
methods.description: Executes a SQL query with string replacement for '||'.

methods.name: MetaPrimaryKeys
methods.description: Retrieves primary key columns for a table from information_schema.

methods.name: SelectLimit
methods.description: Runs a SELECT with limit and offset, implements MSSQL-specific syntax.

methods.name: SQLDate
methods.description: Formats date columns into string representations based on format string.

methods.name: substr
methods.description: Returns SQL substring expression with MSSQL syntax.

methods.name: charMax
methods.description: Returns maximum size for CHAR/VARCHAR fields, no limit (NOLIMIT).

methods.name: textMax
methods.description: Returns maximum size for TEXT fields, no limit (NOLIMIT).

methods.name: Concat
methods.description: Generates a SQL string concatenation expression with proper casting.
